headline: Measured, never certification.
doctrine: Measurement, never certification. Verdicts are observations of public bytes at an instant; they are not certifications, endorsements, or warranties. UNMEASURED/UNCHECKABLE are first-class states and are never recorded as 0 or null. Counts are pointers with an as_of, not permanent totals. Corrections supersede with dated provenance.

registry_walk.caveat: The {name} direct shape (/v0/servers/{name}) 404s even for rows that exist in the list; a 404 there is NOT absence. The paginated list walk is the authoritative row source for this index.

smithery_marketplace.depth_cap_note: Unauthenticated listing pagination is capped at 5 pages x 100 rows (500 rows reachable). FAIL for R2 requires an observed entry with verified:false inside reachable bytes; everything else stays UNCHECKABLE.

R1.name: io.github.* namespace ownership declared
R1.semantics: PASS if server.name or packages[].identifier matches ^io\.github\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ (GitHub-account-anchored naming); FAIL if an identifier is declared outside that namespace; UNCHECKABLE if no identifier bytes exist.

R2.name: marketplace verified badge known
R2.semantics: PASS if row joins (qualifiedName / io.github-derived owner/repo slug / normalized homepage or repository URL) to Smithery's complete verified set; FAIL if row joins to a Smithery entry fetched and observed with verified:false; UNCHECKABLE if badge state is not observable in reachable public bytes.
R2.not_badges: publisher self-declared verified_on / verified_via / namespaceVerification are evidence only and are never accepted as marketplace badges.

R3.name: declared-vs-served tools/list
R3.semantics: declared = tool names in row bytes (publisher-provided.tools); served = JSON-RPC tools/list at the row's first public remote endpoint (stateless attempt, then initialize -> notifications/initialized -> tools/list; 8s/request). PASS if both sides exist and name-sets match; FAIL if both exist and differ; UNCHECKABLE otherwise with reason codes.

R4.name: README/docs link present
R4.semantics: PASS if row bytes carry a non-empty readme*/docs*/documentation* field or a repository.url; FAIL otherwise. websiteUrl alone is a homepage, evidence only.

R5.name: licence declared
R5.semantics: PASS if any key license/licence in the row bytes carries a non-empty string; FAIL otherwise (absence of declaration is checkable from the row bytes themselves).

R6.name: release date recency
R6.semantics: release date = _meta.io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/official.publishedAt, falling back to updatedAt, then statusChangedAt. PASS if <= 365 days before as_of (window pinned here); FAIL if older; UNCHECKABLE if no date bytes or unparseable.

reason_legend: default state per rule semantics (R3=U: row declares no tools list, comparison undefined; R2=U: badge state not observable; R6=U: no date bytes)
reason_legend.r3:no-ep: tools declared but no public endpoint in row bytes
reason_legend.r3:denied: endpoint answered but tools/list not obtainable
reason_legend.ev:*: evidence-only probe of a row with no declared tools list (not verdict-bearing)
reason_legend.r6:age=Nd: release date older than the 365-day window

probes.protocol: MCP streamable-http JSON-RPC tools/list; first remote endpoint per row only; no tool invocation and no execution of server code
probes.evidence_sample_selection: first 500 rows in walk order with a public endpoint and no declared tools list

as_of_note: Every figure in this file is a pointer valid at its stated as_of. Re-walk to re-measure.
